metadata.title: A Globular Cluster Toward M87 with a Radial Velocity < -1000 km/s: The First Hypervelocity Cluster

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's only extreme-velocity object, HVGC-1, is a globular cluster near M87 that the authors infer has escaped or will escape the Virgo Cluster, not the Milky Way (T:p5-b8, T:p5-b9). They also conclude that it is not an individual Galactic star (T:p2-b13, T:p3-b2).
